## Problem and resulting behavior / 问题与结果

Describe the concrete trigger and before/after result. Link an agreed proposal
for a new feature, integration, architecture or policy change.
说明具体触发条件和前后结果；新增功能、集成、架构或政策改动链接已讨论的提案。

## Scope and public contract / 范围与公开约定

List affected rules and intentional behavior changes. Identify any pending
product decision. Keep unrelated work out of the diff.
列出受影响规则和有意改变的行为，注明待决定事项，排除无关改动。

## Validation / 验证

State checks actually run and meaningful before/after evidence. Identify the
commit/host for model or host observations and disclose label exposure if relevant.
Say what remains unverified; CI alone does not remove Alpha HOLD.
记录实际检查和前后证据；模型/宿主观察注明 commit/宿主，适用时披露标签暴露情况。
说明未验证部分；CI 本身不解除 Alpha HOLD。

## Data, sources and compatibility / 资料、来源与兼容

- [ ] Submitted files contain no private resumes, state, contacts or credentials.
- [ ] Added material identifies its source/license where needed; user files and authorship are preserved.
- [ ] Historical inputs, labels and results are unchanged, or an explicitly approved versioned revision is identified.
- [ ] Support/acceptance claims match the evidence; any state compatibility or runtime impact is explained.

提交文件无私人资料；新增材料说明必要的来源与许可；保留用户文件和作者署名；
历史输入/标签/结果保持，或注明已批准的版本修订；支持和验收声明与证据一致。
